about.name: Abdulfatai Lawal
about.tagline: Turning complex data into clear, actionable insights.
about.availability: Open to data analytics & research roles
bio: I'm an MSc Statistics graduate with hands-on expertise in data analytics, predictive modeling, and advanced quantitative research. I work with tools like R, SPSS, Stata, Minitab, Power BI, and Excel to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets.

Over the past 8+ years, I've supported academic research, led survey analysis projects for government and development organizations, and mentored students in applied data analysis. My work spans health, energy, productivity, and social sciences.
I'm passionate about using statistical insights to solve real-world problems — and about training the next generation of analysts.

bullets: Teach undergraduate statistics courses and supervise practical lab sessions in applied data analysis.
Guide students on data analysis projects, academic paths, and course content.
Mentor students in statistical software (R, SPSS) and research methodology.
Analyzed data on the 'Effect of Naira Redesign on Nigerians' Productivity'.
Analyzed data on the 'Impact of Fuel Scarcity on the Productivity of MSMEs in Nigeria'.
Handled data entry, coding, output processing, interpretation, and reporting.
Processed and analyzed data for the Galaxy Backbone Customer Survey.
Managed data entry, coding, output processing, interpretation, and reporting.
Processed and analyzed 1,794 questionnaires from the 'Positive Voices Campaign Project's Baseline Survey' across six Nigerian states.
Delivered cleaned datasets, coded outputs, and analytical reports to stakeholders.

projects.name: Weibull-Fréchet Proportional Hazard Model
projects.description: Developed a parametric survival model applied to tuberculosis patient data, published on SSRN. Compared fit against Cox proportional hazards using real clinical datasets.

projects.name: Naira Redesign & Productivity Study
projects.description: Analyzed survey data for the National Productivity Centre on the effect of the 2023 naira redesign on Nigerian productivity. Delivered cleaned datasets and analytical reports.

projects.name: MSME Fuel Scarcity Impact Analysis
projects.description: Quantified the impact of fuel scarcity on the productivity of Nigerian MSMEs for the National Productivity Centre. Handled end-to-end data pipeline: entry, coding, analysis, reporting.
